name: Seed of Amaranth
source:
What does it take to be a hero, and at what cost? In the irradiated kingdom of Amantia, six characters struggle with this question, bringing them into conflict and unexpected friendships with each other.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/888750/Seed_of_Amaranth/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
成为英雄需要什么，又要付出怎样的代价？在遭受辐射的阿曼提亚王国，六名角色努力寻找答案，并因此陷入冲突，也建立了出人意料的友谊。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/888750/Seed_of_Amaranth/]Steam[/url]]
